reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is aligning noisy biomechanical time series with idealized reference models. MotionDTW addresses this via a two-stage warping cost that penalizes non-monotonicity, yielding stable keyframe correspondences. KISMAM then quantifies deviations from targets using differentiable functions, producing interpretable diagnostics. SportsRAG integrates these metrics into natural language guidance, closing the loop. Failure occurs when target models are absent or when temporal jitter overwhelms the alignment cost. These primitives form a compositional pipeline: alignment → assessment → guidance, enabling automated coaching.
